concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-issuing-webhook-types-fund-transfers-webhooks]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Issuing bank-transfer webhook guide: outgoing and incoming balance-account states, later transaction events and possible post-booking outgoing failure.

Outgoing authorised example caption says transfer.created but payload type is transfer.updated; transaction example field tables include a counterparty transfer-instrument ID omitted from example JSON.
